clue.text: He just couldn't lie about when doing so much laundry

definitions.meaning: the first US president, famous for the cherry-tree story in which he could not tell a lie
washing a ton of clothes, read as two words

explanation.surface: Someone too honest to fib about how much washing they get through.
explanation.definitionFit: George, the first American president, is the legendary truth-teller, while 'washing a ton' describes a vast heap of laundry.

clue.text: Uncooperative habit

definitions.meaning: someone refusing says '...', the contraction
a custom or usual practice

explanation.definitionFit: A refusal is voiced with the contraction of 'will not', and the same letters form an old word for a custom.

clue.text: All is forgiven, but do stop discussing sexual appeal

parts.note: an instruction to stop talking about something: speak no further on the topic
IT is old slang for sex appeal, as in the 'It girl'

explanation.surface: A partner forgives a lapse but begs that the matter of attraction be dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used to close a quarrel, signalling the offence is pardoned and need not be raised again.

clue.text: Small superimposed photograph, part of a collection

definitions.meaning: a little picture set within a larger one on a page
included within a set, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: A small picture placed within a bigger one is an inset, and something belonging to a group is 'in set'.

clue.text: Distribute, but unfortunately run short

definitions.meaning: hand round, as leaflets are handed out
become exhausted or fail, as supplies do

explanation.definitionFit: To hand things round is to give them out, and supplies that are exhausted also give out.

clue.text: Porridge AA motel dished up

indicators.note: food dished up is served in a new arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Breakfast porridge served at a roadside motel run by the motoring organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Porridge is made by cooking ground oats in water or milk.

clue.text: Breezy admirers

parts.note: devoted supporters, and also devices that make a breeze

explanation.definitionFit: Enthusiastic supporters share their name with the handheld devices that stir the air.

clue.text: Market for silver gilt article

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
or is the heraldic word for gold
a is the indefinite article

explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece the open public square served as the marketplace.

clue.text: People who watch a trot take place through glasses

indicators.note: the shuffled letters run through the middle of the glasses word

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles

indicators.note: the letters of the words are made to take a new place, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Spectacle-wearers watching a horse trotting past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take place' rearranges A TROT into TATOR, which goes 'through' SPECS.
explanation.definitionFit: Onlookers at an event are its audience.

clue.text: Two things chess enthusiasts aim to do for a childhood friend

parts.words: Two things chess enthusiasts aim to do
parts.note: chess fans want to play a game

parts.words: Two things chess enthusiasts aim to do
parts.note: and to checkmate the opponent

explanation.surface: A riddle about the goals of keen chess players.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's companion in games is a chum from early years.

clue.text: Poet who changed his mind?

parts.note: someone changing their mind first says a refusal
and then switches to agreement

explanation.surface: A question about a poet who could not make up his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: Alfred Noyes was an English poet, author of 'The Highwayman'.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Noyes was an English writer of verse, best known for 'The Highwayman'.

clue.text: Overall it represented an essential part

indicators.note: re-presented, so the letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: On the whole, this stood for something crucial.
explanation.definitionFit: A crucial function in something is a key role.

clue.text: Secret cipher for letters written on an envelope

definitions.text: Secret cipher for letters written on an envelope

parts.words: Secret cipher for letters written on an envelope
parts.note: a coded string for mail, which is in fact the address sorting code, not anything secret

explanation.definitionFit: The letters and numbers in an address that route mail form a code for the post.

clue.text: Yes, the way for a baker to get a rise

definitions.text: for a baker to get a rise

parts.note: yea is an old word for yes
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: An affirmation about how a baker makes bread rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Bakers add this fungus to dough so it ferments and rises.

clue.text: Apologise if your purchase proves unsatisfactory

definitions.meaning: withdraw a remark, saying sorry
return a faulty buy to the shop

explanation.definitionFit: Withdrawing words is retracting them, and a faulty buy is returned to the shop.

clue.text: See 2
Unrestrained hostility of a summer campaign?

definitions.meaning: conflict fought without limits on means or targets
a summer is someone who sums, and their campaign is the battle to add up

explanation.definitionFit: All-out conflict is unlimited warfare, and a 'summer', one who adds figures, would wage a war of totals.

clue.text: Pamphlet with two pages to hire

parts.note: a leaf of a book has two pages, one each side
to let is to rent out

explanation.surface: A two-page handout advertising something for rent.
explanation.definitionFit: A pamphlet is a small printed sheet handed out.

clue.text: Astronomical measure of a disappointing harvest

definitions.meaning: the distance travelled by light in a year
a year with a light, poor crop

explanation.definitionFit: Astronomers measure distance by how far light goes in a year, and a meagre crop makes a 'light' year.

clue.text: One who puts up an English parson

parts.note: a rector is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A man who builds things, and an English clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who raises or constructs a structure is its builder.

clue.text: Straighten up a rule incorporating Alabama

indicators.note: the rule word takes the state abbreviation into its body

parts.note: to reign is to rule
AL is the postal abbreviation for Alabama

explanation.surface: Correcting a ruling that takes in a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: To set things back in a line is to straighten them.

clue.text: Though venerable in years, with right on his side, he retaliates

indicators.note: the title sits inside the years word

parts.note: age means a period of years
Ven. is the abbreviation for Venerable, a title of archdeacons

explanation.surface: An elderly man, with justice on his side, strikes back.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes revenge for a wrong is a vengeful figure.

clue.text: Egyptian god turning up first class remedy for the faint-hearted

parts.note: Ammon (Amun) was the chief god of Thebes

indicators.note: in a down clue the first-class letters are read upwards, back to front

parts.note: A1 means first class, written with I for the figure 1

explanation.surface: An Egyptian deity becomes a first-rate cure for timid souls.
explanation.definitionFit: Smelling salts, based on this pungent gas, revive people who feel faint.

clue.text: Promising material

definitions.meaning: '..., short for 'it will', is a promise
a woven fabric with diagonal ribs

explanation.definitionFit: The old contraction for 'it will' gives an assurance, and the same letters name a ribbed cloth.

clue.text: Amin reverting to type

parts.note: Idi Amin was the Ugandan dictator

indicators.note: the short word is turned round, going back the other way

explanation.surface: A dictator falling back into his old ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Type' is a person, as in 'a stupid type'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool is a certain kind of person, a sort, in casual speech.

clue.text: Sounds as though armour is not heavy enough for this gun

indicators.note: the clue says what is heard when spoken

parts.note: armour that is too slight is armour-light

explanation.surface: A soldier fears their protection is too flimsy for this weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a brand of lightweight rifle.

clue.text: Underweight blonde

definitions.meaning: not heavy enough
pale in colour, of hair

explanation.definitionFit: Something weighing little is not heavy, and pale hair is fair rather than dark.

clue.text: Single child is a motoring danger in wet weather

definitions.text: a motoring danger in wet weather

parts.note: kid is informal for a child

explanation.surface: An only child is a hazard on rainy roads.
explanation.definitionFit: On wet roads a car may slide out of control.

clue.text: I'm in a state of liveliness

indicators.note: the words before sit inside the state

parts.note: a nation is a state

explanation.definitionFit: Spirited vigour and energy is a lively quality.

clue.text: Tongue of land between Italy and Turkey

definitions.meaning: a language

definitions.text: of land between Italy and Turkey
definitions.meaning: belonging to the country lying between those two

explanation.definitionFit: Hellenic is both the language of Athens and the adjective for the country between Italy and Turkey.

clue.text: Bird which flies on the end of a string

definitions.meaning: a bird of prey

definitions.text: which flies on the end of a string
definitions.meaning: a toy flown in the wind

explanation.definitionFit: The bird of prey shares its name with the toy flown on a line.

clue.text: Partner due to be agitated and smitten

indicators.note: the letters are stirred up, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A partner expected to be worked up, and lovestruck.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone smitten is delighted and captivated, in rapture.
